text: THE NASHA MUKT BHARAT ABHIYAAN BAND IS GONE FROM THE WEBSITE HOME PAGE. It was the campaign's hub while it carried "Take the Pledge" and "Find a De-addiction Centre"; both became sections of their own — Take a Pledge gathers the NMBA and Senior Citizens pledges with the two volunteering registers, and the centre finder is the working locator rather than a link to it. What was left was a third door to the same campaign holding one link to the NMBA portal and the 14446 helpline, which National Helplines already lists, so the page introduced one campaign three times over. The Figma reference has its own copy of that band switched off for the same reason. The photograph stays in the NMBA organisation page's gallery, which is where it came from. Two consequences followed it. Take a Pledge takes the muted tone, because the campaign band was the tinted edge between it and Organisations and two white bands in a row read as one long stretch — Figma paints that section grey too. And the volunteering pair inside it now declares no fill rather than `bg/neutral/subtler`, which is the same colour as the grey band it now sits on; Figma draws those two unfilled, held by their border, under the two white pledge cards.
